d:
In this video, Dr. Vikas Divyakirti has explained in detail the system of America's presidential election, and how this system has changed from time to time from 1788 to 2020.
By watching this video, you will also be able to understand the following interesting concepts:
1) Primary & Caucus
2) Nomination conferences
3) Swing/Purple/Battleground states
4) Election day
5) Electoral College
6) Faithless electors
